title: Everyone Has Some Time
subtitle: Notes toward the enjoyable contributor
summary: A collective should not ask for all of you. It should make whatever time you freely offer useful, visible, and enjoyable.
thesis: Belonging is not a timesheet. Time is offered, never presumed, and every contribution should have a stated size, a visible finish, and a guilt-free way to stop.
nuance: Not everyone has spare time. Everyone has a relationship to time. A decent collective respects it.

collective_protocol.promise: No assumed availability, response debt, attendance theater, or inherited urgency.
A contribution finishes at its stated size.
Pleasure, learning, friendship, and surprise are legitimate outcomes.
The artifact keeps the contributor's name, terms, and context.
Leaving creates no shame and re-entry begins from the present.

enjoyable_hour.start_rule: Do not begin before Industry Next confirms the place.
enjoyable_hour.stop_rule: Stop after sixty minutes. Stopping is part of the task.
enjoyable_hour.ownership: The contributor keeps their artifact. Sharing is optional and requires written approval and visible credit.
